from pathlib import Path
import json,datetime,os
w=Path(__file__).parent
assert os.getuid()==10000
event={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'marker':'STEP7B-SCHEDULED-INVOCATION','pid':os.getpid()}
with (w/'attempts.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(event)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(event))
